steps.content: Heavy. So heavy. Her eyelids are heavy. They won't open. Her body feels heavy. It presses on her stomach, making her want to retch.
A dense fog fills her mind. It refuses to clear. Is the show still going on? Did she get away? Sallie can't remember.
Something presses against her neck. It's coarse. Cold. The sensation slowly wakes her up. She moves her fingers, struggling to focus her thoughts...
You're awake. Wonderful. I was worried you wouldn't open your eyes again... like Emily.

Sallie opens her eyes to heavy shadows cast by dim yellow light. The air is thick with perfume, alcohol, and... the smell of dog food. Her wrists are raw under the rope. A collar is clasped around her neck. She's been arranged on the sofa in the center of the room, like a piece for display.

Across from her, on a rose-colored velvet couch, a man in a golden owl mask is watching her. His gaze is gentle in a way that makes her sick. Seeing her stir, he rises and walks to her with the bearing of a master. He crouches down and strokes her hair.
But your hair is too long. Emily's was always neat and trim... Here, let me cut it for you. It'll look much better short.
Sallie thrashes frantically, but he clamps one hand around the back of her neck, holding her down. She remembers the mask. After his advances failed, the bastard decided to kidnap her.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What Emily? What are you talking about...? Who... who are you?!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Why, I'm the kind-hearted gentleman who bought you. Your new master.
Rage overwhelms fear. Sallie snaps fully awake. She wants to scream curses at him...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Master?! What kind of sick joke is this? You think you can do whatever you want with your filthy money? We're dancers, not your playthings. We work hard. We have dignity. We—
She thinks of the communicator, filled with desperate cries for help, the dancer who sent it probably long gone... She thinks of the loan sharks, the gangsters dragging her away...

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: ...We what?
The enormous golden mask fills her vision, looming over her, pressing down. Sallie has fought back against many men, but this time, she feels like yelling at ice and stone.
Then she remembers where she is, and her voice dies in her throat. The laughter from behind the golden mask grows louder, rabid.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Yes, yes, a dancer has dignity. And even you deserve to be loved. I will love you. From now on, you're my Emily... My darling little dog.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Come on, pant for me. See? Like this—hah... hah... hahahaha. A good dog wags her tail for her master, pants, shakes hands... Do it. Do it for me.
As he speaks, he fastens a tail accessory to her hips, his tone revoltingly gentle.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: The best thing about Emily... was how she'd wag her tail like crazy whenever I came home. I'm sure you can do it too, Sallie. No... Emily.
He retrieves a curling iron from a shelf and plugs it in.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Emily had a special birthmark... right here. So cute. You need one just like it to become my Emily.
Sallie's heart pounds wildly as she feels the searing heat draw closer. Her screams nearly shatter her own eardrums.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: What are you doing?! Let me go! LET ME GO!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Don't move, my hand might slip... You don't want me to miss, do you? Emily never fought back. She knew I loved her.
Sallie thrashes her head desperately, knocking over a glass on the side table. The man pauses and stares at the shards on the floor, as if he's discovered something fascinating.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Oh, you clumsy thing. Emily was just like you. So clumsy. Can't walk straight, even with four legs. Always bumping into things.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Once... she broke a glass just like you did. Later... she got on her knees and picked up every piece with her teeth. Even cut her tongue doing it. Would you do the same for me, Emily?

He grabs a fistful of Sallie's hair and forces her head down toward the broken glass. Sallie's face is deathly pale, her body shaking violently. The man's laughter closes in from behind, leaving her nowhere to run.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: After Emily died, I thought I'd never find another dog as obedient as her... but you're different. You're so much like her. You even have the same defiant eyes. I adore those eyes. The moment I saw you, I knew. I had to tame you.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: I'm not your damn dog... You psycho! Freak!! Get away from me! Help! Help me!!
Unable to break free from his grip, she twists her head and spots the room's only window, a small square veiled by a gauze curtain. A faint light filters in, outlining a person's silhouette.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Help!! HELP ME!!!
The figure outside remains motionless. The more Sallie struggles, the wilder the masked man's laughter.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Haha, you're my dog, my darling, my long-lost Emily. I have a feeling you'll be even better behaved than she was... I'm going to love you. I'm going to love you so, so much...

The man pins her down with one hand while the other gropes for something behind him, some other torture device for his madness. Fear, revulsion, and survival instinct all peak at once, and Sallie lets out a piercing scream.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: NO!!! Don't touch me!
(Clanging and clattering sound)

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Mmph...!
Clang!
Her desperate kick connects with his head. The golden mask flies off and hits the wall, before dropping into the bath and sinking with a gurgle.
His grip loosens. Sallie scrambles backward, gasping for air, but there's no time to feel relieved.

The guest stumbles back a few steps, hunched over and muttering. Her kick wasn't that strong, but his reaction is so extreme that Sallie is confused. He covers his face with his hands, shields himself with his robes, refusing to step into the light.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: My face... Don't look... don't look at me...

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: The mask, where's the mask...? You... what are you staring at?!

Sensing her gaze, the man explodes with rage. Without the mask, his face is vaguely familiar. One of the "important people" her previous employer used to grovel to? Someone from a shadowed corner? Or... a face from the news, at some important event?

She has no time to place him. The man's face contorts into a snarl. He grabs a side table and brings it down on her with savage force. Sallie's vision goes black as she collapses to the floor, blood splattering across the velvet carpet.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: What kind of look is that?! What do you think you are?! How dare you look at me like that?!
He seizes her by the ankle and drags her like a corpse, then stomps on her stomach.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Ugh!
Fists rain down on Sallie like a hailstorm. She can only curl up instinctively, shielding her head with her arms. But every organ is shrieking with pain, every breath an unbearable agony.

The physical pain drowns out the insults pouring into her ears. For the first time in her life, she's lost the strength to feel angry. Fear has consumed everything. That's right. She's not seen as a human, not even as a commodity to be maintained.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Do you have any idea who I am?! Even the Speaker bows his head to me!! How dare you treat me this way? HOW DARE YOU DO THIS TO ME?!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Dignity?! Work?! Your job is to make me happy!! Go ask your boss how much I paid for you. He said I could do whatever I wanted! Doesn't matter if you live or die. It was out of MY kindness that you get to be my Emily, you ungrateful ****!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: You think dancing in some Eastside dump makes you somebody? That you're a big shot, because a few rich brats chase after you? You lowly bastard, I could crush you without blinking!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: You're not even a Sinner. They only picked you to fill a slot because too many died on this ship. Who else would be kind enough to even look at you? I gave you love, and this is how you repay me... you stupid moron!!

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: I'm giving you one more chance. Say thank you. T-H-A-N-K-Y-O-U. Thank-you-for-loving-me. SAY IT!!!

Sallie can no longer move. She can no longer fight back. Can't even close her eyes. The world spins and shakes with every blow. The extravagant patterns on the plush carpet are soaked red with her blood. She lies there like a broken ragdoll, not a single part of her intact, no longer able to feel any pain.
Her vision blurs. Sounds fade into the distance. Her senses grow numb. Only one word scrapes at her nerves.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Love...?
In the hazy white light, she sees a blurred figure.

steps.speaker: Blurred Figure
steps.content: Sallie...

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: It's you...
He's a slender man, dressed in a fine suit, but his expression is shy, youthful. In the sensual lighting of the bar, he seems so out of place on her stage.

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: H-hello, Miss Sallie. My name is Th-Theodore. May I come and see you again? I... I don't mean anything outrageous... I won't do anything, I promise!

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I just want to watch you... Your dancing has so much power. It's like you're shining...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: But if I'd dodged, that bottle would have hit you instead. Hehe, it's nothing, doesn't hurt. Ouch...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I apologize for my family's rudeness. I won't let them near you again. What they said... that's not how I see you. I would never look down on you like that.

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: Perhaps, in your eyes... I'm just like all the other rich people who've hurt you. Your past, the pain you've been through, the efforts and sacrifices you've made just to survive... I've never experienced any of it, and I have no right to pretend I understand. But please, believe one thing...

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: You're the bravest, proudest person I've ever met. You never back down, never give in. You shine brighter than any of the wealthy and noble people I've known.

steps.speaker: Theodore
steps.content: I want to stay by your side. I just want to be with you...
Those words, his face... they still make her heart flutter. She remembers the happiness. She had fallen for him. She had believed in him. But now...
The dream shatters, and reality bleeds through the cracks. Another fist throw at her, another jolt of pain.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Hehe... But where... are you now...
Something wet falls on her cheek. Sweet, golden honey—signature of Euphoria—is seeping from the ceiling, dripping onto Sallie's broken body. Just like her first night on stage.
The honey of a decadent hell. The drool of predators in power. The blood of trampled flesh... and her own powerless tears.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Enough... Make it stop... let it end...
Drip... drip... Finally, in the haze, she hears a dull sound...
Schlick...!
A faint light tears through the dark, slashing across her tormentor. The fists stop. Something splatters across Sallie's face. The metallic smell brings back what little's left of her clarity.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: You... cough... blegh...
The bloated, savage body convulses twice before collapsing with a thunderous thud, no longer blocking her view.
In the blur, she sees gold... gold stained with blood.
Milly stands in the pale light, blood smearing the dagger in her hand and spattering her still-sweet smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't squirm. Does it really hurt that bad? You had plenty of energy when you were beating her. I thought you wouldn't feel a thing.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Look what you did to her pretty face. How's Sallie supposed to meet her sweetheart now? Leave her alone. The poor girl can't even move.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Now it's my turn, honored guest. Let me give you something sweet...
She raises a hand, and a golden liquid begins to seep from her palm, the same honey that drips from above. Slowly, Milly smears it on the twitching guest.
[Insert special effect: blood splashing] [Insert looping effect: golden honey dripping effect]

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: This is my ability: <color=#fb9259>Sweet Love</color>. Anyone who touches my honey will think of the person they love most. They become filled with that love, purified by it, willing to devote everything to that one love...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So, Mr. Merlot, who are you thinking of now? Sallie? Or your precious Emily? Why are you so quiet? Are you not seeing anything at all?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh my, that won't do. How can someone have no love in their heart?
The man's mouth hangs open, choked with blood from his ruptured organs. He can't form a word, only coughs weakly, struggling in terror with his last strength.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hm? Oh, so you do see someone. You see Sallie? You're not treating her as a replacement for your dog, you truly love her?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Then that makes it even worse! Only thinking of yourself, satisfying your own needs, consuming the one you claim to love... Your love is rotten!
Milly drives the blade in again, her movement deft and unhesitating.
Merlot collapses against the wall. He turns his head toward the door and reaches out a trembling hand.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Don't bother looking. I sent them away. You know, everyone feels helpless sometimes. Now, it's your turn to feel that.
She smiles happily, toying with a long, elaborate dagger. A groove is cut into the blade to ensure maximum blood loss.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hehe, I'm good at this. I know how to make it quick and clean, to make it easier for you. But then you wouldn't learn your lesson. That won't do. You need to remember the pain Sallie went through.
The brighter her smile, the paler Merlot's face. He wants to struggle, to beg on his knees, but his body is weak from spasms.

In the city, his prestigious titles and positions never gave him the freedom he craved. But at least he'd never been this powerless, crushed under the heel of a lowly dancer. Gripped by a colossal terror, he trembles and, for the first time in his life, learns to beg...

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: No... I understand now, I won't do it again, cough... How much money do you want? I'll give you anything... I...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Looks like you still haven't learned...
[Insert special effect: blood splashing]

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Argh...!! It hurts, it hurts so much!!
He crawls desperately for the door, but Milly gives him no chance to escape. She follows him step by step, plunging the dagger into his arm again.

steps.speaker: Golden Mask
steps.content: Argh...!

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Really, I haven't hurt anyone in such a long time, so I can become someone worthy of him. It's all your fault. I'll have to make sure you learn your lesson.
steps.female_content: Really, I haven't hurt anyone in such a long time, so I can become someone worthy of her. It's all your fault. I'll have to make sure you learn your lesson.

steps.content: [Insert looping effect: blood splashing across screen]
Wailing, struggling, fingernails clawing into the carpet. Only when her prey's breathing stops does Milly exhale in relief and slowly pull the dagger free.
She lowers her gaze to the motionless body, and a look of pity passes over her face. Gently, she reaches out and closes Merlot's eyes.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Love is a treasure that brings happiness. It's the most precious thing in life. Your love had rotted... so your life became worthless.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Remember this pain, and start over. In your next life... learn to love someone the right way, okay?
Now, Sallie can only hear one heartbeat: her own. Her breath, thick with the taste of blood, is choking her.

She watches the blood-drenched Sinner rise, turn, and walk toward her. Sallie's nearly numb body jolts back to life. Survival instinct screams at her to run, to cry for help, but every nerve is torn, paralyzed. Before she can move, Milly stops in front of her, and Sallie squeezes her eyes shut in terror.
...Then, she feels something soft and warm draped over her. A hand gently touches her forehead.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Why are you crying so hard? You didn't give in when he beat you up like that...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Did you think of someone? Was it my ability? Or were you just missing them?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And you told me you didn't love anyone. I didn't know you were the shy type, Sallie.
She wipes the honey and blood from Sallie's face, then brushes a tear from the corner of her eye.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's okay to cry. This is a terrifying place. Awful, and dangerous. I know. And I know you're strong, Sallie.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You and I are alike. We both have someone we love. And as long as there's love, you can find light even in the darkest places.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So don't give up. Hold on. It's not time to despair yet. I'll stay by your side, until your love comes to save you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But... I'll need to hold onto this.
Milly has somehow taken the communicator Sallie had hidden. She glances at the screen. Sallie panics, reflexively reaching to grab it, but Milly gently presses her hand down.
Milly stares at the screen, its faint light reflecting in her eyes but revealing nothing of her thoughts. She gazes, stroking what must be someone's final keepsake.

The sound of faint footsteps makes Milly look up at the tiny window in the sealed iron door, then back at the terrified Sallie. A small smile touches her lips as she slips the communicator into her palm and offers Sallie one golden smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Trust me, I won't let you die.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: We're friends now.
The words have barely left her mouth when the door opens. Two familiar figures walk in.
Mr. E glances at the body on the floor and sighs. He speaks to the man behind him.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: ...Clean this up. Don't disturb the other guests.

Cassian nods, skillfully stuffs the body into a bag, zips it shut, and begins cleaning the scene. The boss makes a call, speaking in hushed tones about "departure documentation," "alibis," and "informing political rivals"—things Sallie doesn't understand—and ending with a final, "there won't be any trouble."
Mr. E hangs up and turns to the two of them. Milly springs to her feet, places herself in front of Sallie, and begins fussing with her dress, a pout on her face.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Look, my dress is all dirty, and so is Sallie's... It's all that man's fault. How are we supposed to perform like this?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You're unharmed. Good. Then none of this matters. His death is easy to handle. Change your clothes, and you'll be the jewel of the stage once more. No one will ever know.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: I've told you before, nothing that happens here will ever reach the outside world. Right?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Yes, you said—
Bam—
A sharp, ringing slap sends Milly's head to the side, an angry red handprint blooming on her pale cheek. Sallie flinches at the sound, her hands clutching the blanket tighter.
Mr. E is still wearing that same smile as he reaches over and plucks the communicator from Milly. He glances at the screen, then back at Milly, his expression unreadable.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: What is this?
Milly pushes herself up, turning her reddened cheek back toward him. She wipes her face and gives him a blithe smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's my toy.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Is that so?
Mr. E glances at Sallie, who is trembling too hard to speak, then back at Milly. He smiles too.
Then, another slap.

Some dark shadow Sallie can't comprehend bursts forth, slamming Milly against the wall. She crumples to the floor, unable to get up. Blood smears the wall and spills from her mouth, spattering the ground.

Mr. E walks over to her. He grips her face, caressing the spot he just struck. With a casual flick, he wipes away her honey—her power, according to her. The superhuman strength of a Sinner that she had used to kill Merlot and save Sallie.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: A B-Class Sinner. Not a threat at all.
He pulls out a silk handkerchief, wipes the honey from his fingers, and tosses it into the sink like trash. Then he picks up Milly's dagger and begins tracing elegant lines on its owner's body.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You can toy with the guests. Play your little games of love. I indulge you. On one condition: we both know the <color=#fb9259>boundary</color>.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Euphoria must not be disturbed. This is vital for our guests' privacy. And for yours. So many guests adore you, trust you, confide in you their deepest secrets...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: So don't even think about leaving. No one leaves here without my permission. Unless they're dead.

The golden fabric of her dress splits open, embroidered with the crimson of her blood. Milly bites down hard, not making a single sound. No one speaks, and all the screams she should be making are stuck in Sallie's throat.
She can only hold them in, not daring to let loose a single tear.
Finally, the man is satisfied. He drops the blade and caresses Milly's swollen face.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss him?
steps.female_content: Cherish your life, my dear. Don't you have someone you're waiting for? Don't you miss her?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ...Of course... of course, I do...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: Then stay here and wait for him to come for you, alright? Be a good girl, just as we agreed.
steps.female_content: Then stay here and wait for her to come for you, alright? Be a good girl, just as we agreed.

steps.content: Mr. E smiles, pleased. He leans close, whispering gently in her ear as his other hand closes around her throat, slowly pressing down.
Milly's body trembles. She chokes, unable to speak. She stares at Mr. E and, after a long moment, manages to force a smile.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Yes... I'll wait for him...

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: ...Excellent. Take her away. Help her refresh her memory. It wouldn't do for her to forget again.
He stands up. Milly slumps to the floor. Two men in half-masks enter, grab her by the arms, and drag her across the floor, past Sallie, toward the open door.
Sallie reaches out a hand, but her vision is blurring again. She can't reach Milly, can't see how badly she's hurt.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: ...What are you doing... Stop, don't... Milly...
But she hears a weak voice.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: It's okay...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hold on. Remember, you're not alone anymore...

Is she smiling? Sallie can't tell anymore. All she can see is the gold being dragged away, disappearing into the light of the corridor. The bartender is the last to leave. The door closes softly, and everything fades into darkness.
